lines.rom: arati kije sri ramalala ki raghunamdana sampurna kala ki
narayana nara banakara aye raghukula namdana rama kahaye kausalyasuta rajivalocana dasarathasuta hari bhavabhaya mocana
bharata lakhana satrughana sameta pragate avadha mem krpaniketa dhanusa bana divya divyayudha dhari jana mana ramjana avadha bihari
guru vasistha se vidya paye visvamitra ka yajna bacaye tara ahilya mithila aye janakasuta se byaha racaye
